title: Robust Regression
interviewAnswer: Robust regression reduces the influence of extreme residuals compared with squared-error OLS, using losses such as Huber or alternative estimators.
keyPoints: Differentiate data errors from valid heavy tails.
Robust loss changes influence, not the data itself.
Compare with quantile regression when conditional tails matter.
why: Robust Regression appears frequently in data-science work because it connects mathematical assumptions to practical decisions, diagnostics and failure modes.
intuition: Differentiate data errors from valid heavy tails.
deepDive: Robust regression reduces the influence of extreme residuals compared with squared-error OLS, using losses such as Huber or alternative estimators. Robust loss changes influence, not the data itself. Compare with quantile regression when conditional tails matter. A strong practitioner separates the modeling assumption from the estimation procedure, checks diagnostics rather than trusting a single score, and explains what would make the method inappropriate.
workedExample: Fit delivery-time relationships without allowing a few outage days to dominate coefficients.
commonMistakes: Applying the method without checking its assumptions or data-generating process.
Choosing it because it is familiar rather than comparing against an appropriate baseline.
followUps: What assumptions does Robust Regression make?
How would you validate or debug Robust Regression in practice?
production: In production, validate assumptions on real data, monitor the quantities that can drift, and keep a simple baseline so added complexity has a measurable reason to exist.
